class LinkPolicy
  class << self
    def external?(url)
      uri = URI.parse(url)
      return true if uri.host.nil?

      local_domains.none? { |domain| same_server?(uri, domain) }
    rescue URI::InvalidURIError
      true

    def same_server?(uri, domain)

      uri.host.casecmp?(local.host) && uri.port == (local.port || uri.default_port)
    end
  end
